decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Sufficient details of fume and odour control have been provided in relation to the large retail food store only in order for the Council to be satisfied that neighbours' living conditions will have been adequately protected in accordance with the planning permission and adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and ENV-P.1.6 (Air Pollution).

Condition : 2 - Informative:  These details apply to the large retail food store (ASDA) only.  Prior to first occupation of the proposed A3 unit, the Health Club and the medical centre, details under this condition will need to be submitted to and approved in writing by the Council for all of these uses where necessary.
description: Following the approval for the demolition of existing houses, social club and some retail premises and the comprehensive re-development of key site 1 with the erection of a mixed use development comprising multiplex cinema, leisure and recreational facilities, town square, large retail units, shops, restaurants, offices, hotel, health and fitness centre, creche, medical and dentistry centre, private and residential, key worker housing, together with improvements to surrounding access router improvements to public transport including how pedestrian link to Hounslow central underground station and the construction of 2 new road links between the site and the high street, and construction of car parks, access and service roads and landscaping - partial details submitted pursuant to Condition 30 (control of fumes & odours) of approved planning permission 00616/F/P5 dated 31/7/02 relating to Asda Store only
